rows.text: The Xianzhou Fanghu frequently dispatches large-scale eco-ships to other segmenta, carrying out scientific expeditions and diplomatic missions in place of the main ship. Each eco-ship is loaded with a large amount of supply of the Fanghu's own celestial traces: the waters of the Roiling Deep. This spirit water, brimming with life force, sustains the vessel's internal ecosystem while also serving as a vital power source. The Vidyadhara harness cloudhymn arts to command the spirit water, driving a propulsion device known as the "Seaflow Chakra," satisfying both demands at once. The water flows through the Chakra in endless cycles of rising and falling, transmuting between entropic energy and spiritual essence, much like the life of a Vidyadhara itself.
